note: Mechanical two-witness referent-color evidence. Distributions/curve published; NO threshold baked, NO recommendation, NO adoption.

witness_A_pixels.corpus: COCO instances_val2017 (5000 images ALL present on disk; train2017 images ABSENT so val-only)

color_bin_rule.space: RGB(0-255) -> HSV via standard conversion; H in [0,360), S,V in [0,1]
rule_ordered: (H >= 300 or H < 10) and S < 0.55 and V >= 0.70 -> pink (light desaturated red/magenta)
color_bin_rule.declared: These boundaries ARE the rule (part of the measurement), not tuned.

witness_A_pixels.per_instance: dominant bin = modal per-pixel bin over the decoded mask; category histogram = counts of instances by dominant bin

zh_color_terms.source: HowNet W_C whose ANY DEF carries a color sememe under FIELD_SEMEME_GLOSS['color'] (verbatim from latent_written_labeler_53 / word_latent_v1_52)

witness_B_cross_language.survival_cut: PROVISIONAL: ratio >= 2 in BOTH languages (reported alongside raw ratios; re-cuttable)
witness_B_cross_language.mapping: COCO english<->zh and pool zh<->english via HowNet W_C/W_E pairs

gaps: Pixel witness uses val2017 ONLY: train2017 instance annotations exist on disk but train2017 images do NOT, so pixels come from the 5000 val images.
Pixel witness covers COCO's 80 categories only; pool words (incl. all 7 named referent-candidates) have NO pixel referent sample unless their English form equals a COCO category (none of the 7 do).
Instances with <25 masked pixels skipped (per-category count in n_skipped_small).
446 crowd instances all use uncompressed list-RLE (decoded); zero compressed-string RLE, so no crowd instance was dropped for decode reasons.
Route B word identity: COCO->zh and pool->en via HowNet W_C/W_E; a category/word with no HowNet cross-form is invisible on that language side (ratio=None).
Multiword English forms matched by substring; single words by whole-token set membership. ZH matched by tokenizer token membership (segmentation-dependent).
